sources.title: README.md · XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL at main - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: MiMo-V2.6-Pro-RL is the flagship checkpoint of the MiMo-V2.6 series. The series is built to scale reinforcement learning toward self-improvement — scaling RL compute, environment diversity, and grader compute together, so the model keeps expanding its capability frontier through exploration and feedback.
